response.text:
Ordnung does not store a separate "contribution start date" field for this notice — only the first payment date is recorded. The letter itself names an effective date, but that value is only in the letter text, so I can't state it as confirmed here; please check it on the paper letter.

What is confirmed:
- The increased monthly contribution of 156.55 € is first collected by direct debit on 15 Oct 2026, and repeats monthly (next due 15 Dec 2026) [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe].
- This is from the notice "Beitragsbescheid" sent by Muster BKK on 10 Sep 2026, filed for Alex Rivera [doc:doc_9t9tmrv1ypba].
- There is also an open (overdue) decision item about whether to object to this assessment, with a send-by date of 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg] — note that objecting does not stop the higher amount from being due in the meantime, per the letter.

So based on Ordnung's own records, the higher amount takes effect with the direct debit on 15 Oct 2026 [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe]; for the exact calendar date the insurer says the new rate "applies from," check the letter directly.
